semantics.collective_bytes_logical: sum of gradient tensor bytes submitted per bucket per rank, not physical network bytes
semantics.collective_sum_host_s: sum of async NCCL Future completion durations; overlapping operations double-count
semantics.collective_span_host_s: last callback minus first launch, host-side span, not GPU NCCL kernel duration
semantics.backward_with_comm_s: backpropagation incl overlapped AllReduce; not additive with collective time
semantics.step_s: training step duration after batch available, excludes dataloader next() wait
semantics.batch_wait_s: time spent in next(loader) including initial iterator and epoch overhead as seen by training process
semantics.resources: GPU samples per rank; NIC RX/TX counters node-global on local_rank==0 only, includes non-training traffic
semantics.gpu_idle_proxy: fraction of device samples below threshold; not precise GPU idle time
semantics.contact_metrics: not applicable to E1_a stable link; E2 contact trace required for utilization/outage analysis
semantics.time_to_accuracy: first observed validation crossing; sampled at epoch boundaries
semantics.instrumentation: registered custom DDP comm hook, same dense average as default DDP; timing overhead may change throughput
semantics.peer_metadata: worker_map.json lists ranks, hostnames, IPs; DDP collectives do not expose exact per-rank NCCL transport byte paths
